newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria charges Soyinka, 11 others with treason.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria charges Soyinka, 11 others with treason.

text.p: Nigeria's military government charged exiled Nobel laureate Wole Soyinka and 11 others on Wednesday with the capital offence of treason over recent bomb blasts in the country.
Court officials said some of the charged were leaders of the opposition in exile but that those in the country were brought to court. The case was adjourned to May 9.

The charge sheet listed among those charged as Anthony Enahoro, the leader of NADECO-Abroad, the exiled wing of the opposition group NADECO and Frederick Fasehun, president of the Campaign for Democracy pressure group as well as former finance minister Olu Falae.
The last two have been detained since December after a spate of bomb explosions hit army buses, killing at least three soldiers and wounding several dozens.
The plea they entered in court was not immediately known.

Nigeria has been in crisis since 1993 when the army annulled an election to restore democracy. Soyinka and some of those charged with him have campaigned to have the poll recognised as legitimate and the winner installed president.
